title: THE SHOT LEAVES THE BIG GUN MUZZLE
why: His order of 2026-10-12, third part: with the bigger guns the flash, the tracer and the brass still came from the old small gun. Every shot showed two flashes, an old disc at the gun tip and a star a little lower and further back, the tracer started inside the gun, and the brass popped out at the feet. Now each body remembers where its gun was drawn, and every shot shows ONE flash, the star, at the drawn muzzle (a bigger star on the long guns and the Support MG). The tracer shows nothing while the round is still inside the gun, starts at the muzzle and eases down to its old lane over its first stretch, and the brass flies out of the ejection port. A teammate shot in your window flashes at his drawn muzzle too. Draw only: every round still leaves from the same point with the same range, spread and hits, and nothing new is sent to the party.
now: Every shot now flashes once at the muzzle of the big gun, and the tracer and the brass come out of the gun.
